 Sunday Night Football: DeShon Elliott inactive after suffering pregame knee injury
 By
 Myles Simmons , 
 By
 Myles Simmons 
     Published November 15, 2026 07:02 PM 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Email
 The Steelers will unexpectedly be missing one of their key members in the secondary for Sunday night’s game against the Bengals. 
 Pittsburgh announced that safety DeShon Elliott suffered a knee injury during pregame warm-ups and has been ruled out for the contest. 
 Elliott has been healthy for just two games this season, but was slated to be on the field coming out of Pittsburgh’s bye. 
 Elliott is inactive along with quarterback Drew Allar, quarterback Will Howard, cornerback Sean Murphy-Bunting, and running back Eli Heidenreich. Howard is Pittsburgh’s emergency third quarterback. 
 Defensive tackle Derrick Harmon is active after he was taken off of injured reserve this weekend. 
 For the Bengals, Dalton Risner is active for the contest after dealing with an illness. Safety Kyle Dugger, center Connor Lew, offensive tackle Myles Hinton, and defensive tackle Landon Robinson are inactive.
